entry.title: What installed skills cost in context
entry.summary: Anthropic says you can install many Claude Code skills without context penalty, at about 100 tokens per skill. In my transcripts the per-skill figure holds, but the full listing is paid in every session, grew 72% in three months, and 18 of its 50 skills were never invoked.

entry.title: Measuring coding agents by what happens to their code
entry.summary: A comparison of four Claude models on 612 coding sessions from my own repositories. I detected no difference in how much of their code survived, but how much of my usage limit each session used, measured in weighted tokens, differed clearly. Method, results with 95% intervals, and limits.
